summary: The Toronto dossiers are mostly sound, but live checks exposed one cross-dossier contradiction and two stale gaps: Masai Ujiri left the Raptors in June 2025 (culture was right; fanbase, rhythm, uniform and both retail dossiers still had him in charge, now fixed), the 2025-26 City Edition is a recolor of the 2021-22 champions tribute (now recorded), and the Tempo did open in 2026 at Coca-Cola Coliseum. Other fixes: four (not five) Cup group games, Oct 30 no longer treated as a confirmed home opener, Dick's ownership of Foot Locker Canada, an invented 15% share, a Boxing Day home-game assumption, and a stereotyping Pacific Mall line were corrected or removed, along with weakly sourced Caribana trademark and Houdini details. The strategy brief needs editor work on the Oct 30 and Kawhi timing, the "never put city streets on a jersey" claim, the Home Stop palette versus the current City Edition, and partner and retail-door status; most small businesses and sponsor deals remain unverified in the queue.
